verses.text: LORD, you are always right when I bring a complaint to you. Yet I want to talk to you about justice. Why do the wicked succeed? Why do all the unfaithful live such easy lives?
You planted them, and they have put down roots. They grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips, but far from their hearts.
But you know me, LORD. You see me and test my heart toward you. Drag them away like sheep to be killed. Set them apart for the day of slaughter.

How long will the land be dry, and the grass in every field wither? Because the people who live there are wicked, the animals and birds have died. For the people said, "He will not see what happens to us."
"If you have raced with people on foot and they have worn you out, how can you race against horses? If you stumble in a safe land, what will you do in the thick bushes along the Jordan?
Even your own brothers, your own family, have betrayed you. They have shouted loudly against you. Do not trust them, even when they say nice things to you.
I have left my house. I have abandoned my inheritance. I have handed over the people I dearly love to their enemies.
My people have become to me like a lion in the forest. They roar at me, so I hate them.
My people have become like a speckled bird of prey, attacked by other birds of prey on all sides. Go and gather all the wild animals. Bring them to eat.
Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trampled down my field. They have turned my pleasant field into an empty wilderness.
They have made it a wasteland. It mourns before me, empty and ruined. The whole land is ruined, because no one cares.
Destroyers have come over all the bare hills in the desert. For the sword of the LORD destroys from one end of the land to the other. No one is safe.
They planted wheat but harvested thorns. They wore themselves out but gained nothing. They will be ashamed of their harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD."

This is what the LORD says about all the evil nations around Israel, who take the land I gave my people Israel as their inheritance: "Look, I will pull them up from their land, and I will pull up the people of Judah from among them.
But after I have pulled them up, I will again have mercy on them. I will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own land.

And if they will carefully learn the ways of my people, and make their promises in my name, saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' just as they once taught my people to make promises by Baal, then they will be built up among my people.
But if any nation will not listen, I will completely pull it up and destroy it," says the LORD.
